content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a D6-vs-C1 collision by comparing the challenger's chain and the defender's chain and their footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter","rule_words":"A link is judged by its support, never by whether any verse, or the chain as a whole, states it word for word","room":"states it word for word: either it bans only requiring exact wording while allowing a not-named defect, or it bans treating lack of explicit naming as a defect; I read it as the latter","why":"The judge faults the challenger's chain for not naming Joseph, which is a word-for-word defect barred by the rule rather than a weighing of the chain's footing."}
